title: Has anyone dreamed this ?
content: Basically my dream starts in a completely blank mall, there was some kind of table in the middle where you could see a hologram of the mall map and you could move it and you could hear the walls changing, from there there was another person, a girl, she and I could transform into animals, I remember going through some pipes with brick walls, it's the only place with that aesthetic in the dream, then I go out to some pipes and vents where there is a hole through which I could get out, a guy on a sled comes out of nowhere, the guy is a homeless person who shouts something and comes out through that small hole despite having a big sled, then I transform into a bird and manage to get out, when I got out it was a forest, the other person didn't come out, I passed out and woke up in a warehouse with many hospital beds arranged in a straight line, I get up and see the horizon and the beds are infinitely, the place is totally empty
